market.rules_primary: If Dallas wins the Green Bay at Dallas professional football game originally scheduled for Sep 28, 2025, then the market resolves to Yes.
market.rules_secondary: The following market refers to the team who is the winner (or participant awarded a tie) in the Green Bay at Dallas professional football game originally scheduled for Sep 28, 2025. If this game is postponed or delayed, the market will remain open and close after the rescheduled game has finished (within two weeks). If the cancelled game is not played or is rescheduled further than two weeks out, the market will resolve to a fair price for each team in accordance with the rules. If the game is declared a tie, the market will resolve to 50/50 for both teams.
